--- format: html: suppress-bibliography: true --- # Essential Genes Analysis {.unnumbered .unlisted} ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tidyverse) library(ggVennDiagram) library(ggpubr) library(plotly) library(scales) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Define folder paths FOLDER_PATH <- Sys.getenv("BOX_PATH") TnSeq_folder <- file.path(FOLDER_PATH, "Tn-Seq") sites_folder <- file.path(TnSeq_folder, "sites") genomes_folder <- file.path(TnSeq_folder, "RefSeqs") dataframes_folder <- file.path(TnSeq_folder, "tables") if (!file.exists(dataframes_folder)) { dir.create(dataframes_folder, recursive = TRUE) } figures_folder <- file.path(TnSeq_folder, "figures") if (!file.exists(figures_folder)) { dir.create(figures_folder, recursive = TRUE) } ``` ::: ## Data Preparation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # List all *.TRUE.DESeq.csv files recursively files <- list.files(path = sites_folder, pattern = ".TRUE.DESeq.csv", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE) # Extract subfolder names and get the part after the underscore subfolder_names <- basename(dirname(files)) cleaned_names <- sub(".*_", "", subfolder_names) # Read all the files into a list and rename based on cleaned subfolder names data_list <- lapply(files, read.csv) names(data_list) <- cleaned_names # Clean column names in each data frame data_list <- Map(function(df, cleaned_name) { colnames(df) <- gsub(paste0("_", cleaned_name), "", colnames(df)) df }, data_list, cleaned_names) # Combine all datasets into one and add a Condition column EG_data <- bind_rows( Map(function(df, cleaned_name) { df %>% mutate(Condition = cleaned_name) }, data_list, cleaned_names) ) # Levels Re-factoring and column renaming EG_data <- EG_data %>% select(-X) %>% mutate_if(is.character, as.factor) %>% mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("input", "lac"), labels = c("Input", "LAC"))) %>% rename_with(~ gsub("_TRUE", "", .), everything()) %>% rename(log2FC = log2FoldChange, Sample1_numreads = Sau_USA300_FPR3757.1, Sample2_numreads = Sau_USA300_FPR3757.2, Sample1_numsites = Sau_USA300_FPR3757.1.1, Sample2_numsites = Sau_USA300_FPR3757.2.1) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Identify samples with less than 10 reads in both samples for the Input condition lowcount_genes <- EG_data %>% filter((Condition == "Input" & (Sample1_numreads < 10 & Sample2_numreads < 10))) # Filter those lowcount_genes from EG_data EG_data <- EG_data %>% filter(!(id %in% lowcount_genes$id)) # Count genes with at least 10 reads in either sample for each condition detected_genes_input <- EG_data %>% filter((Condition == "Input" & (Sample1_numreads >= 10 | Sample2_numreads >= 10))) detected_genes_LAC <- EG_data %>% filter((Condition == "LAC" & (Sample1_numreads >= 10 | Sample2_numreads >= 10))) nrow(detected_genes_input) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 2505 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} nrow(detected_genes_LAC) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 2434 ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Wide version of the dataframe for scatter plots EG_data_wide <- EG_data %>% select(id, genes.name, log2FC, padj, stat, Essentiality, Condition) %>% pivot_wider( names_from = Condition, values_from = c(log2FC, padj, stat, Essentiality), names_glue = "{.value}_{Condition}" ) %>% mutate(log2FC_diff_LAC_vs_Input = log2FC_LAC - log2FC_Input) # Merge df_counts with annotation info Sau_gtf <- readRDS(file.path(genomes_folder, "Sau_KPL4403_Ibberson_annot.rds")) %>% select(-start, -end) EG_data <- left_join(EG_data, Sau_gtf, by = c("id" = "Geneid")) %>% select(-seqname, -score, -frame, -source, -feature) %>% select(Condition, genes.name, everything()) EG_data_wide <- left_join(EG_data_wide, Sau_gtf, by = c("id" = "Geneid")) %>% select(-seqname, -score, -frame, -source, -feature) %>% select(genes.name, everything()) %>% select(genes.name:aa_sequence) # Save dataframes write_csv(EG_data, file.path(dataframes_folder, "TNSeq_5772_EG.csv")) saveRDS(EG_data, file.path(dataframes_folder, "TNSeq_5772_EG.rds")) write_csv(EG_data_wide, file.path(dataframes_folder, "TNSeq_5772_EGwide.csv")) saveRDS(EG_data_wide, file.path(dataframes_folder, "TNSeq_5772_EGwide.rds")) # Read COG names/colors COG_categories <- read_csv(file.path(genomes_folder, "COG24_Categories.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) color_mapping <- setNames(COG_categories$func_COG24_color, COG_categories$func_COG24_CATEGORY) ``` ::: ## Summary Plots ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} # Summarize the number of essential genes by condition Essential_EG_data <- EG_data %>% filter(Essentiality == "Reduced") %>% group_by(Condition) %>% summarize(count = n()) # Create a bar plot plot_num <- ggplot(Essential_EG_data) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", aes(x = Condition, y = count, fill = Condition)) + labs(y = "# Essential Genes", x = "") + scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey", "#FF2400")) + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) + theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 20, b = 0, l = 0)) # Create a list of gene IDs for each contrast where 'selected == TRUE' selected_venn <- EG_data %>% filter(Essentiality == "Reduced") %>% group_by(Condition) %>% summarise(genes = list(id), .groups = 'drop') %>% pull(genes, name = Condition) # Plot the Venn diagram for the contrasts plot_venn <- ggVennDiagram(selected_venn, label = "percent", label_percent_digit = 1, label_size = 4, label_alpha = 0, set_size = 3, set_color = c("grey", "#FF2400")) + scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white", "grey40")) + theme(legend.position = "none") plots_genesDE <- ggarrange(plot_num, plot_venn, ncol = 2, nrow = 1, widths = c(0.7, 1)) plots_genesDE ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Manuscript_DatCol_Tn-Seq_Figures_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){fig-align='center' width=1152} ::: ::: ### EG by COG24 Category Colors: - Information Storage and Processing: Greens - Cellular Processes and Signaling: Reds - Metabolism: Blues ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} EG_COG24_CATEGORY <- EG_data %>% filter(Essentiality == "Reduced") %>% separate_rows(func_COG24_CATEGORY, sep = "!!!") %>% group_by(Condition, func_COG24_CATEGORY) %>% summarize(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') EG_COG24_CATEGORY <- left_join(EG_COG24_CATEGORY, COG_categories, by = "func_COG24_CATEGORY") EG_COG24_CATEGORY <- EG_COG24_CATEGORY %>% mutate( func_COG24_CATEGORY = factor(func_COG24_CATEGORY, levels = rev(COG_categories$func_COG24_CATEGORY)), func_COG24_CATEGORY_SHORT = factor(func_COG24_CATEGORY_SHORT, levels = rev(COG_categories$func_COG24_CATEGORY_SHORT)) ) plot_EG_COG24_CATEGORY <- ggplot(EG_COG24_CATEGORY %>% drop_na(func_COG24_CATEGORY)) + facet_wrap( ~ Condition, ncol = 4) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", aes(x = func_COG24_CATEGORY_SHORT, y = count, fill = func_COG24_CATEGORY)) + labs(y = "# Genes ", x = "") + coord_flip() + scale_fill_manual(values = color_mapping) + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) + theme_bw(base_size = 30) + theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) plot_EG_COG24_CATEGORY ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Manuscript_DatCol_Tn-Seq_Figures_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){fig-align='center' width=2880} ::: ::: ### EG by KEGG Class ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} EG_KEGG_Class <- EG_data %>% filter(Essentiality == "Reduced") %>% separate_rows(func_KEGG_Class, sep = "!!!") %>% mutate(func_KEGG_Class = str_remove(func_KEGG_Class, "^Pathway modules; ")) %>% mutate(func_KEGG_Class = str_remove(func_KEGG_Class, "^Signature modules; ")) %>% mutate(func_KEGG_Class = str_remove(func_KEGG_Class, "^[^;]+; ")) %>% group_by(Condition, func_KEGG_Class) %>% summarize(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') plot_EG_KEGG_Class <- ggplot(EG_KEGG_Class %>% drop_na(func_KEGG_Class)) + facet_wrap( ~ Condition, ncol = 4) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", aes(x = func_KEGG_Class, y = count, fill = func_KEGG_Class)) + labs(y = "# Genes ", x = "") + coord_flip() + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) + theme_bw(base_size = 30) + theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) plot_EG_KEGG_Class ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Manuscript_DatCol_Tn-Seq_Figures_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){fig-align='center' width=2880} ::: ::: ### EG by TIGRFAM Meta Role ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} EG_TIGRFAM_MetaRole <- EG_data %>% filter(Essentiality == "Reduced") %>% separate_rows(`TIGRFAM Meta Role`, sep = ";") %>% group_by(Condition, `TIGRFAM Meta Role`) %>% summarize(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') plot_EG_TIGRFAM_MetaRole <- ggplot(EG_TIGRFAM_MetaRole %>% drop_na(`TIGRFAM Meta Role`)) + facet_wrap( ~ Condition, ncol = 4) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", aes(x = `TIGRFAM Meta Role`, y = count, fill = `TIGRFAM Meta Role`)) + labs(y = "# Genes ", x = "") + coord_flip() + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) + theme_bw(base_size = 30) + theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) plot_EG_TIGRFAM_MetaRole ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Manuscript_DatCol_Tn-Seq_Figures_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png){fig-align='center' width=2880} ::: ::: ## Log2FC Pair Plots ### All Genes ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} scatter_plot_by_pair <- function(data, pair_vals) { # Filter and pivot data pivoted_data <- data %>% select(id, gene, func_prodigal, product, func_COG24_CATEGORY, func_KEGG_Class, `TIGRFAM Meta Role`, Condition, log2FC, Essentiality) %>% filter(Condition %in% pair_vals) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Condition, values_from = c(log2FC, Essentiality)) %>% mutate(across(starts_with("log2FC_"), ~ ., .names = "{sub('^log2FC_', '', .col)}")) %>% select(-starts_with("log2FC_")) %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(selected = case_when( all(c_across(starts_with("Essentiality_")) == "Reduced") ~ "Both", all(c_across(starts_with("Essentiality_")) == "Unchanged") ~ "None", TRUE ~ "One" )) %>% mutate(selected = factor(selected, levels = c("One", "None", "Both") )) %>% ungroup() pivoted_data_COG <- pivoted_data %>% separate_rows(func_COG24_CATEGORY, sep = "!!!") pivoted_data_KEGG <- pivoted_data %>% separate_rows(func_KEGG_Class, sep = "!!!") %>% mutate(func_KEGG_Class = sub(".*?; ", "", func_KEGG_Class)) # Function to create scatter plots with different aesthetics create_plot <- function(data, x, y, aes_params) { ggplot(data, aes(x = !!sym(x), y = !!sym(y), !!!aes_params, text1 = id, text2 = gene, text3 = func_prodigal, text4 = product, text5 = func_COG24_CATEGORY, text6 = func_KEGG_Class, text7 = `TIGRFAM Meta Role`)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) + labs(x = paste("Log2FC for", x), y = paste("Log2FC for", y)) + coord_fixed() + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey20") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey20") + geom_hline(yintercept = -2, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") + geom_vline(xintercept = -2, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) } # Generate plots with different color variables plot_select <- create_plot(pivoted_data, pair_vals[1], pair_vals[2], aes(color = selected)) + scale_color_manual(values = c("skyblue", "grey", "red")) plot_COG <- create_plot(pivoted_data_COG, pair_vals[1], pair_vals[2], aes(color = func_COG24_CATEGORY)) plot_KEEG <- create_plot(pivoted_data_KEGG, pair_vals[1], pair_vals[2], aes(color = func_KEGG_Class)) # Interactive versions plot_select_Int <- ggplotly(plot_select, tooltip = c("text1", "text2", "text3", "text4", "text5", "text6", "text7")) plot_COG_Int <- ggplotly(plot_COG, tooltip = c("text1", "text2", "text3", "text4")) %>% layout(legend = list(font = list(size = 10))) plot_KEEG_Int <- ggplotly(plot_KEEG, tooltip = c("text1", "text2", "text3", "text4")) %>% layout(legend = list(font = list(size = 10))) return(list( plot_select = plot_select, plot_COG = plot_COG, plot_KEEG = plot_KEEG, plot_select_Int = plot_select_Int, plot_COG_Int = plot_COG_Int, plot_KEEG_Int = plot_KEEG_Int )) } ``` ::: ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Plot with Highlighted Genes ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} EG_data_wide <- EG_data_wide %>% mutate( plot_coloring = factor( case_when( genes.name %in% c("dat", "alr", "fmtA", "dltA", "dltB") ~ "condition1", genes.name %in% c("dltD", "racE") ~ "condition2", log2FC_diff_LAC_vs_Input >= -1.5 | Essentiality_LAC == "Unchanged" ~ "condition3", TRUE ~ "condition4" ) ) ) %>% mutate( # Rename some genes genes.name = case_when( genes.name == "alr" ~ "alr1", genes.name == "racE" ~ "murI", TRUE ~ genes.name ) ) ``` ::: ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} plot <- ggplot() + geom_point(data = EG_data_wide %>% filter(plot_coloring %in% c("condition3", "condition4")), aes(x = log2FC_LAC, y = log2FC_Input, color = plot_coloring), alpha = 0.7, size = 2) + geom_point(data = EG_data_wide %>% filter(plot_coloring %in% c("condition1", "condition2")), aes(x = log2FC_LAC, y = log2FC_Input, color = plot_coloring), alpha = 0.7, size = 2) + scale_color_manual(values = c("grey70", "steelblue", "firebrick", "black")) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey") + geom_vline(xintercept = -2.08, color = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) + geom_text(data = EG_data_wide %>% filter(plot_coloring %in% c("condition1", "condition2")), aes(x = log2FC_LAC, y = log2FC_Input, label = genes.name), nudge_y = 0.55, nudge_x = 0.55, color = "black", size = 5) + coord_fixed(ratio = 1) + labs(color = "Color Key", x = "log2FC normalized output from HNO-ALI", y = "log2FC normalized input library") + theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.text = element_text(size = 12) ) plot ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Manuscript_DatCol_Tn-Seq_Figures_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){fig-align='center' width=768} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(filename = file.path(figures_folder, "Tn-Seq_log2FCInputLAC.png"), plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300) saveRDS(plot, file.path(figures_folder, "Tn-Seq_log2FCInputLAC.rds")) ``` ::: ## Enrichment Analysis We generated a custom protein interactions network in [STRING](https://string-db.org) using the **Staphylococcus aureus** subsp. **aureus** USA300_FPR3757 genome (RefSeq: NC_007793.1). The STRING organism ID for this genome is STRG0A72MUM, which can be found here: https://version-12-0.string-db.org/organism/STRG0A72MUM We generated a file with gene IDs and the `log2FC_diff_LAC_vs_Input` as input for STRING's "Proteins with Values/Ranks - Functional Enrichment Analysis". ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} EG_data_STRING <- EG_data_wide %>% select(id, log2FC_diff_LAC_vs_Input) write_csv(EG_data_STRING, file.path(dataframes_folder, "TNSeq_5772_EG_log2FC_diff_LAC_vs_Input.csv")) # use this file for STRING enrichment analysis enrichment_data <- read.delim(file.path(dataframes_folder, "STRING_Enrichment.log2FC_diff_LAC_vs_Input.tsv"), header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) # read the enrichment results from STRING ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plot_enrichment <- function(data, category, fdr_threshold = 0.05, top_n = 10, title = NULL) { df_plot <- data %>% filter(X.category == category, false.discovery.rate < fdr_threshold) %>% arrange(-enrichment.score) %>% head(top_n) %>% mutate( term.label = { if (category == "STRING clusters") { paste0(term.description, " (", term.ID, ")") } else { term.description } }, term.label = str_replace_all( term.label, c("biosynthetic process" = "biosynthesis", "metabolic process" = "metabolism") ), term.label = str_wrap(term.label, width = 25), term.label = fct_reorder(term.label, enrichment.score) ) plot <- ggplot(df_plot,aes(x = enrichment.score, y = term.label)) + geom_segment(aes(x = min(enrichment.score) * 0.92, xend = enrichment.score, yend = term.label, colour = false.discovery.rate), linewidth = 1.2) + geom_point(aes(size = genes.mapped, colour = false.discovery.rate)) + scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C", begin = 0.2, end = 0.9, name = "FDR") + scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), breaks = c(10, 20, 40, 60), name = "Gene count") + scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))) + labs(title = title, x = "Enrichment score", y = NULL) + theme_bw(base_size = 10) + theme( plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14), axis.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 8)), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey80", linetype = "dashed"), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(size = 10), legend.text = element_text(size = 10), ) return(plot) } ``` ::: ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} plot_enrichment_GO_Process <- plot_enrichment(enrichment_data, "GO Process", fdr_threshold = 0.05, top_n = 10, title = "Biological Process (Gene Ontology) Enrichment") plot_enrichment_GO_Process ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Manuscript_DatCol_Tn-Seq_Figures_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-16-1.png){fig-align='center' width=960} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(filename = file.path(figures_folder, "Tn-Seq_enrich_GO.png"), plot_enrichment_GO_Process, width = 10, height = 5.5, dpi = 300) saveRDS(plot_enrichment_GO_Process, file.path(figures_folder, "Tn-Seq_enrich_GO.rds")) ``` ::: ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} plot_enrichment_UniProt <- plot_enrichment(enrichment_data, "UniProt Keywords", fdr_threshold = 0.05, top_n = 10, title = "UniProt Enrichment") plot_enrichment_UniProt ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Manuscript_DatCol_Tn-Seq_Figures_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-17-1.png){fig-align='center' width=960} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(filename = file.path(figures_folder, "Tn-Seq_enrich_UniProt.png"), plot_enrichment_UniProt, width = 10, height = 3.5, dpi = 300) saveRDS(plot_enrichment_UniProt, file.path(figures_folder, "Tn-Seq_enrich_UniProt.rds")) ``` ::: ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} plot_enrichment_STRING <- plot_enrichment(enrichment_data, "STRING clusters", fdr_threshold = 0.05, top_n = 10, title = "STRING Clusters Enrichment") plot_enrichment_STRING ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Manuscript_DatCol_Tn-Seq_Figures_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-18-1.png){fig-align='center' width=960} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggsave(filename = file.path(figures_folder, "Tn-Seq_enrich_STRING.png"), plot_enrichment_STRING, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300) saveRDS(plot_enrichment_STRING, file.path(figures_folder,
